attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_reasoning_and_audit_pipeline

steps:
  - id: fetch_source_data
    op: data/fetch
    params:
      source: request_source
      description: Fetch the source data for the incoming high-value request
    output: raw_data

  - id: classify_data
    op: classify/apply_rule
    params:
      input: "{{raw_data}}"
      rule: classification_rule
      description: Classify the source data to determine the processing path
    output: classification_result

  - id: route_request
    op: routing/decide
    params:
      classification: "{{classification_result}}"
      description: Route the request down the correct processing path based on classification
    output: routed_data

  - id: transform_data
    op: transform/canonicalize
    params:
      input: "{{routed_data}}"
      target_format: canonical_output
      description: Transform the routed data into the canonical output format
    output: transformed_data

  - id: validate_transformed_data
    op: validate/verify
    params:
      input: "{{transformed_data}}"
      validation_rules: canonical_schema
      description: Validate the transformed data before persisting to ensure correctness
    output: validation_result

  - id: authenticate_pipeline_service
    op: auth/authenticate
    params:
      service_identity: pipeline_service
      scope: write
      description: Authenticate as the pipeline service before writing to the data store
    output: auth_token

  - id: store_result
    op: data/persist
    params:
      input: "{{transformed_data}}"
      validation_status: "{{validation_result}}"
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
      description: Store the verified and transformed result to the target data store
    output: storage_confirmation

  - id: notify_stakeholder
    op: notify/send
    params:
      recipient: stakeholder
      message: Pipeline completed successfully for the high-value request
      storage_reference: "{{storage_confirmation}}"
      description: Notify the stakeholder that the pipeline has completed
    output: notification_status

  - id: log_audit_trail
    op: audit/log
    params:
      pipeline_run:
        fetch: "{{raw_data}}"
        classification: "{{classification_result}}"
        routing: "{{routed_data}}"
        transformation: "{{transformed_data}}"
        validation: "{{validation_result}}"
        authentication: "{{auth_token}}"
        storage: "{{storage_confirmation}}"
        notification: "{{notification_status}}"
      description: Log the entire pipeline run including all step outputs for audit purposes
    output: audit_record
